# Package 5 Requirements Checklist: Review, Apply, Verify, Undo, and Reset

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer check of Package 5 requirement completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, recovery, security, accessibility, and evidence scope
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Authority and Scope Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are proposal, review, apply, verification, projection, undo, reset, and history outcomes all explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec FR-001–FR-021]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the boundary between current Package 5 work and Package 6/7 work explicit and internally consistent? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Is visible UI mediation defined as the only source of approve/reject/revoke authority? [Security, Spec FR-003–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the unchanged two-tool WebMCP inventory stated clearly enough to prevent accidental expansion? [Scope, Spec FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are local-only proof and every hosted/manual/external exclusion stated without implying completion? [Evidence, Spec Assumptions; SC-011]

## Proposal and Decision Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are every displayed immutable proposal field and the `NOT APPLIED` semantics specified? [Completeness, Spec FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is edit-as-child behavior unambiguous about parent immutability, child authorship, evidence lineage, and supersession? [Clarity, Spec FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Are approve, reject, and revoke bindings measurable for proposal ID, digest, base revision, reviewer, page session, and time? [Measurability, Spec FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Are decision replay, conflicting key, invalid transition, and foreign/nonexistent behaviors defined? [Coverage, Spec FR-004; Edge Cases]

## Guarded Apply and Recovery

- [ ] CHK010 Is the apply caller input closed to exactly proposal ID, expected revision, and idempotency key? [Clarity, Spec FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Are all execution-time authority sources that must be re-resolved explicitly named? [Completeness, Spec FR-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the exact successful mutation relation quantified without leaving optional success rows? [Measurability, Spec FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Are zero-row guard, downstream zero-row, statement failure, and final completeness failure requirements explicit? [Exception Coverage, Spec FR-009; Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are same-key replay and same-key different-request outcomes distinct and testable? [Clarity, Spec FR-010]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the 100-pair concurrency outcome quantified for winners and forbidden duplicates/partials? [Measurability, Spec FR-011; SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 Are lost-response-before/after-commit recovery and UI uncertainty requirements defined without guessing? [Recovery, Spec FR-024]

## Verification and Projection

- [ ] CHK017 Is a fresh finalized raw rehearsal for the exact revision required before verification? [Completeness, Spec FR-014]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the exact conditions for pass-only, reviewed, applied, exact-once projection complete? [Clarity, Spec FR-015–FR-017]
- [ ] CHK019 Is projection provenance defined across proposal, review, application, verification, workspace, variant, behavior, outcome, and edges? [Traceability, Spec FR-016]
- [ ] CHK020 Are seed immutability and failed/unreviewed/revision-1/replay non-projection states explicit? [Coverage, Spec FR-016–FR-017]

## History, Undo, and Reset

- [ ] CHK021 Are all material history record classes and chronological/reload expectations enumerated? [Completeness, Spec FR-013; FR-021]
- [ ] CHK022 Is undo defined as a new forward revision with no pointer rewind or history rewrite? [Clarity, Spec FR-018]
- [ ] CHK023 Is permanent invalidation of the old approval after undo or later revision explicit? [Security, Spec FR-019]
- [ ] CHK024 Are reset confirmation, generation replacement, prior-workspace inaccessibility, other-workspace isolation, and replay recovery all specified? [Coverage, Spec FR-020]

## Request, Privacy, and Non-Oracle Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Are malformed, oversized, content-type, Origin, CSRF, session, and unknown-field rejection requirements complete? [Security, Spec FR-022]
- [ ] CHK026 Is foreign/nonexistent response equality quantified beyond error code to status, envelope, size class, and timing budget? [Clarity, Spec FR-023]
- [ ] CHK027 Does the history contract exclude raw session, CSRF, identity, rationale payload, event array, SQL, path, and secret data? [Privacy, Data Model Safe history union]

## Accessibility and Browser Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are keyboard access, restrained live announcements, native dialog semantics, and background inertness defined for changed states? [Accessibility, Spec FR-025]
- [ ] CHK029 Are desktop, 320 px, 375 px, 200% zoom, reduced-motion, and focused-control visibility requirements all explicit? [Coverage, Spec FR-025; SC-008]
- [ ] CHK030 Is Cancel focus after application a named observable acceptance outcome? [Clarity, Spec FR-012]
- [ ] CHK031 Are uncertain-network and reload states specified as functional UI states rather than premium polish? [Consistency, Spec FR-021; FR-024]

## Testing, Migration, and Evidence Quality

- [ ] CHK032 Is migration `0004` explicitly conditional on a failing real-D1 enforcement test while migrations `0001`–`0003` remain immutable? [Constraint, Spec FR-026]
- [ ] CHK033 Does the verification command requirement preserve every inherited Package 4 assertion and enumerate Package 5 additions? [Completeness, Spec FR-027]
- [ ] CHK034 Are coverage obligations identified for canonicalization, reducers, guarded-result interpretation, and new server operations? [Measurability, Spec SC-009]
- [ ] CHK035 Are reviewer findings, dispositions, convergence, source binding, evidence binding, exact-clone proof, and cleanliness all required? [Evidence, Spec FR-028; SC-010–SC-011]
- [ ] CHK036 Can each success criterion be proven by a named current-state artifact or command without relying on intent, screenshots alone, or HTTP success? [Acceptance Quality, Spec SC-001–SC-011]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
